people.name: Queen_of_Sheba
people.line: A queen who visited Solomon and praised his wisdom

people.name: Sheba
people.line: Kingdom known for wealth, trade, and the Queen of Sheba

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: She gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, spices in great abundance, and precious stones. There was never before such spice as the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.
translations.bsb: Then she gave the king 120 talents of gold, a great quantity of spices, and precious stones. There had never been such spices as those the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
translations.kjv: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Solomon.
translations.asv: And she gave the king a hundred and twenty talents of gold, and spices in great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.
